description: Read metered database execution usage: schedule runs and webhook attempts per UTC hour or day window. from and to are UTC timestamps with milliseconds (Z), aligned to the granularity, at most 31 days apart. Only completed windows are final. The counts are counters only: executions have no price of their own, and the awake compute time of the database is what is billed.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: database_execution_usage_get
